resources.string: Record voice message. Hold to record, tap to start.
The server %1$s answers, but the connection is not encrypted.
That does not look like a server address.
Could not reach the server. Check the address, your internet connection and, if you use Tailscale, that its app is connected.
The server has no valid certificate (TLS). The app does not connect to servers with invalid certificates.
The server answered with error %1$d. Is this the right address?
The address starts with http://. Messages are still end-to-end encrypted, but your password and metadata travel in clear text. Use this only for development on your own network.
Always connect with https://. Messages are end-to-end encrypted either way, but TLS protects your password and who talks to whom.
Private family chat. Messages are end-to-end encrypted and stored on your own server.
Shown to others, for example “Anna added a new device”
Use 3–32 characters: a–z, 0–9, dot, underscore, hyphen
The password must be at least 10 characters
Could not reach the server. Try again when you are online.
The invitation code is invalid, used or expired.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
The account already has the maximum number of devices. Remove one in the settings on another phone, then log in again.
You are not allowed to do that.
The file is too large. The limit is 100 MB.
The input was not accepted. Check it and try again.
Your session ended, for example because this device was removed or the password was changed. Please log in again.
The server reported an error. Try again in a moment.
Only https:// is allowed. Unencrypted http:// works only in the development build and only for local network addresses.
The file could not be opened or shared.
Your messages cannot be opened right now
The phone\'s key store did not answer. Nothing has been deleted. Try again in a moment, or restart the phone.
The microphone is needed for voice messages. Allow access and try again.
Tap the plus button to write to someone in your family.
Write the first message. It is encrypted before it leaves the phone.
Not sent. Tap to try again.
This message could not be decrypted
The sender\'s safety key has changed. The message can be read once you accept the new key.
The message is deleted for everyone in the conversation.
The safety number for %1$s has changed
A new device was added to your account (%1$s)
%1$s added a new device (%2$s). Nothing is sent to it until you approve it.
A new device was added to your account (%1$s). Nothing is sent to it until you approve it.
You will no longer receive messages from the group, and earlier messages disappear from this device.
They will no longer receive messages from the group.
Compare the numbers with the person, in person or on a call. If they match, nobody is in the middle. Every device has its own number.
No devices with keys found yet.
The number is available once you have exchanged the first message.

This device\'s safety key has changed. It may be a new phone or a reinstall, but it can also mean someone is pretending to be the person. No messages are sent to or accepted from the device until you accept the new key.
This device was added next to a device you have verified. It may be a new phone, but it can also be somebody trying to listen in. Nothing is sent to or accepted from it until you approve it.
The key does not match the device list on the server and cannot be accepted. Try again later.
Verify your own devices so that new devices on the account must be approved
Only accept if you compared the new number with %1$s (device %2$s) in person or on a call, or know that the device is new.
All other devices are logged out when the password changes.
The password was changed. All other devices were logged out.
Admins only. The code is shown once.
Send the code to the person in a safe way. It is shown only now and can be used once.
The device is logged out at once and receives no more messages. Use this if a phone was lost.
Off. Tap to change in the system settings.
Push goes through an app on the phone, for example ntfy, that receives wake-up signals from your server. No Google, and no content in the signals.
No distributor app is installed. Install ntfy (from F-Droid or Google Play) and open this dialog again.
No distributor app installed. Install ntfy.
Registration failed. The app still syncs every 15 minutes.
Choose the language of the app. The change applies at once.

Messages, attachments and file names are encrypted on the phone with the Signal protocol. The server sees only who writes to whom and when, never the content. Passwords and keys never leave the device unencrypted. The app is free software (AGPL-3.0).
This device is removed from the account and all messages and keys are erased from the phone. Old messages cannot be read again if you log in later.
Shown briefly while the app fetches new messages
Offline – messages will be sent when you are back online

resources.string: You are leaving Swahn Chat. Check the whole address before you continue.
The address contains unusual characters or hidden parts. Double-check it.
No app could open the link
All devices are verified. Open safety numbers.
A safety key changed or a new device is waiting for your approval. Review.
Applies to notifications and the lock screen. Replying from the notification is not offered when no name is shown or when the app lock is on.
No screenshots and no preview in the recent apps list
Unlock with fingerprint, face or screen lock
Set up a screen lock or biometrics on the phone first.
Search all messages. The search happens only on this phone.
You can pin at most %1$d conversations.
No notifications. Unread messages are still counted.
The message is removed from this phone, including downloaded attachments. Everyone else in the conversation keeps it.
The times are the ones the server sent with the receipt. Someone who reads silently sends no read receipt; a dash is shown then.
What is fetched without a tap
Space per conversation, clear media and cache
The new person chooses “New with invitation” and “Scan invitation”. The code is only good for this invitation.
Choose what is fetched by itself when a message arrives. “Wi-Fi only” means when the phone is not on mobile data or on a network you marked as metered.
You can always fetch an attachment by tapping it. Very large files are never fetched automatically.
Messages stay. Cleared media can be downloaded again as long as it is still on the server. Attachments you sent yourself and imported media are not touched.
Downloaded media in %1$s (%2$s) is removed from this phone. The messages stay and the attachments can be downloaded again as long as the server has them.
All downloaded media (%1$s) is removed from this phone. The messages stay and the attachments can be downloaded again as long as the server has them.
Temporary files (%1$s) are removed. No messages or attachments are affected.
Ask %1$s to show their QR code for the safety number (Show QR code) and point the camera at it.
QR code for the safety number
Let the other person scan the code with their phone.
The safety number for %1$s is the same on both phones. Nobody is in the middle.
The new safety number for %1$s matches the other phone. You still decide yourself whether to accept the key.
The code does not match the safety number for %1$s. Someone may be in the middle, or you scanned the wrong device or person. Do not trust the device until you have compared the numbers again.
This is not a safety number QR code (device %1$s). Ask the person to choose “Show QR code” on the safety screen.
The camera is needed to scan. You can allow it here, or in the app settings.
This device has no camera. You can compare the numbers by hand.
Point the camera at the QR code the administrator shows. The code only fills in the server address and the invitation code; nothing is sent until you press the button.
Check that this is the server you expect. The code decides where the account is created.
The address contains international characters that can imitate another name. Only continue if you recognise it.
This is not an invitation to Swahn Chat.
The invitation is from a newer version of the app. Update the app or type the details by hand.
The QR code is too long to be an invitation.
The invitation has the wrong format and was not used.
The server address in the invitation is not valid and was not used.
The invitation points to a server without https. For safety it is not used.
The invitation code in the QR code is not valid and was not used.
Tap your reaction to remove it
Reactions. Tap to see who reacted.
You can choose at most %1$d conversations.
Could not forward. Check the connection and try again.
Attachments are re-encrypted with new keys. The copy follows the disappearing-messages timer of the conversation it is sent to.
New messages are removed from every phone in the conversation a set time after they are shown. Messages already sent are not affected.
Only administrators can change the timer in a group.
The server removes its copies of encrypted messages on the same schedule. Your phone only follows the timer that members sent encrypted.
Update the app to see everything
You can send at most 10 files in one message.
Sign in to Swahn Chat first, then share again.
%1$d shared files were not accepted (too large, wrong type or not allowed).
What you tried to share could not be accepted.
At most 10 files can be shared at once. The rest were left out.
Move your history to a new phone

Creates an encrypted file with your conversations and messages (text and details about them) and, if you like, the pictures, videos and files. No keys, sessions or sign-in details are included. Messages that disappear are left out. The file can only be opened with the passphrase, which is not stored anywhere.
Only those downloaded to this phone. The file gets larger.
Choose where to save and export

Adds messages from an exported file to this phone\'s history, marked \"Imported\". They are not sent again and do not touch any keys or sessions. Only conversations that already exist on this phone receive messages.
The passphrase you chose when you exported.
Done: %1$d messages in %2$d conversations were exported.
%1$d messages were left out (disappearing, unsent or failed).
%1$d were already here or have been deleted here.
%1$d belong to conversations this phone does not have and were skipped.
%1$d records were invalid and were skipped.
This is not a Swahn Chat history file.
The file is from a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.
The file uses settings this app does not accept.
Wrong passphrase, or the file is damaged. Nothing was imported.
The file is damaged, incomplete or has been changed. Nothing was imported.
The file is larger than the app accepts. Nothing was imported.
The file belongs to another account.
The content of the file is not valid. Nothing was imported.
The file could not be read or written.
The file is gone (it was not part of the export)
Hides your IP address from the person you call. Uses the server\'s bandwidth and needs TURN on the server. The call is still end-to-end encrypted.
Currently off: an incoming call only shows as a notification. Tap to change.
The call could not be connected
The call goes via a new device of %1$s that is not verified. Compare the safety number if you are unsure.
The call goes via a new device of the other person that is not verified. Compare the safety number if you are unsure.
You are already in a call
Calls need access to the microphone. Allow it in the system settings.
The call could not be started
Press and hold a message and choose Star. Stars exist only on this phone and are never sent.
A question and at least two options. Votes are encrypted, like everything else.
Nobody can vote any more. The votes stay.
Nobody has voted for this option.
The message is sent when the phone is online and may be a few minutes late. It is encrypted when it is sent.
Choose a time at least one minute from now.
You can schedule at most 30 days ahead.
Press and hold the send button to choose when a message is sent.
It has never been sent, so nobody else will know.
Your location is read once and sent encrypted to this conversation. No map service gets to know it, and it does not follow you afterwards. Choose how exact it should be.
This can take up to 30 seconds.
Everyone in the conversation can see and save it. It is sent once.
The map app you choose will see this location.
There is no map app on this phone.
The app has not been allowed to use your location. Allow it in the phone settings if you want to share a location.
Location is switched off. Turn it on in the phone settings and try again.
No location was found within 30 seconds. Go outdoors or check that Location is on, and try again.
The location could not be used. Try again.
No photos or videos in this conversation yet.
No files in this conversation yet.
No links in this conversation yet.
The camera needs your permission to take photos and record video. Allow it in the phone settings.
The video could not be compressed and is sent in original quality.
Messages that arrive during quiet hours: they are listed but make no sound, no vibration and no pop-up
Could not open the notification settings
During these hours messages arrive silently: no sound, vibration or pop-up, but they are listed with the notifications. Calls ring as usual unless you choose otherwise below.
Hours that cross midnight belong to the day they start.
Incoming calls do not ring during quiet hours. They are still shown and can be answered.
Off: others do not see when you have read their messages. You still see other people\'s read receipts.
Off: nothing is sent while you type. You still see when others are typing.

Off by default. On: people you share a chat with see whether you are online and when you were last. You see other people\'s status if they have turned it on, whatever your own setting. When you turn it off the server forgets your last-seen time.
Stronger colours and clear outlines. All text has at least 7:1 contrast. Patterns behind messages are hidden.
Pick a chat in the list and it opens here.
The code is invalid, already used, replaced by a newer one or expired. Ask the administrator for a new code.
There must be at least one active administrator. Name another administrator first.
This device has no push address registered, or the server cannot send push.
The account is suspended. Contact the administrator.
Ask an administrator of the server to create a reset code for you. The code works once and for 24 hours. Ask for it in a way you trust, for example in person.

When you use the code, the password changes and all your other devices are signed out. This phone becomes a new device with new keys. Your old messages stay on the other devices but cannot be read on this phone. Your contacts get a notice about a new device and may need to approve it.
The code identifies your account, you do not need to type your username.
Four short steps: notifications, push, battery and safety numbers
Without notifications you will not notice a message or call until you open the app. A notification shows only what you have chosen to show, see Privacy in the settings.

The app does not use Google. To get new messages straight away while the app is closed you need a small push app, a so-called UnifiedPush distributor. The push message says nothing about what was written, it only wakes the app.
A common choice is ntfy. Install the app, come back to this page and choose it below.
No push app is installed yet.
Push is on and the server knows this device.
No push app is chosen yet.
Let the app run in the background

Messages are end-to-end encrypted. To be sure you are talking to the right person, compare safety numbers or scan a QR code with them, preferably in person. You find it under the person\'s name in a chat, and for your own devices under Settings.
The push server accepted the test (answer %1$d). You should see a silent sync within a few seconds.
The push server refused the test (answer %1$d). Check the push app and that it is connected.
The push server did not answer. Check that the push app has a connection.
The test was sent but the server has not reported a result yet. Try refreshing in a moment.
No push address is registered for this device, or the server cannot send push.
You have tested too many times. Wait a few minutes.

Android can hold apps back to save battery. Push and calls may then arrive late or not at all. If you exempt Swahn Chat from battery optimisation they arrive straight away. It costs little battery, since the app does not run all the time and is only woken by push.
The app is exempt from battery optimisation
The app can be held back by battery optimisation
May be held back. Tap to allow in the background.
Connection, push, outbox and a log to send to support
Here you can see why something does not work. Nothing on this page contains messages, names, keys or addresses with a path.
Not shown: the server tells only administrators (see Administration, Status)
Push address registered with the server
The server\'s last push to this device
Not needed, the app does not use them
Copy gives a summary without secrets. Export adds the log of the app\'s own events.

• the summary above (host name, version, status)\n• %1$d lines about the app\'s own events: syncs, push, realtime connection, failed sends (kind of error only), call phases, background jobs\n• ids only as short hashes

• messages, names, usernames or phone numbers
• passwords, keys, tokens or the push address
• IP addresses or web addresses with a path
• anything about the content of calls or who you spoke to
You choose where the file is saved and who you send it to. The app sends nothing.
The log could not be saved.
Messages that are waiting or could not be sent
These are messages the server has not accepted yet. The app tries to send them again by itself as soon as it can.
All your messages have been sent.
The message to %1$s is never sent and is removed from this phone. This cannot be undone.
No contact with the server. The app tries again when there is a connection.
The server asked the app to wait. Trying again shortly.
The server answered with an error. Trying again.
The recipient\'s devices have changed. The app is fetching them again.
A device has a new key and waits for your approval. Compare safety numbers in the chat, then try again.
The message or file is too large.
You are no longer in the chat.
The attachment is no longer on the phone or on the server.
Name, last seen and push for each device
These devices are signed in to your account. Remove a device you do not recognise or have lost.
New devices wait for your approval (%1$d)
Someone signed in to your account on a new device. If it was not you, remove the device and change your password. If it was you, compare the safety numbers and approve it.
The name is shown to you and to the people you talk to, so they can tell your devices apart.
Push status is shown only on the device itself
Push: registered, the last attempt worked
Push: registered, the push server did not answer last time
Push: registered, the push server refused last time (answer %1$d)
Removes the account on the server and all data on this phone
Step 1 of 2: this is what happens
Step 2 of 2: confirm with your password
If you delete the account, this happens:
All your devices and keys are removed on the server and you are signed out everywhere.
You leave all chats and groups.
Messages you have sent stay with the others in the chats.
Files that no message refers to any more are deleted from the server.
All messages, keys and files are deleted from this phone and the app returns to the start screen.
If you are the only administrator you must first name another administrator.
Enter your password to delete the account.
Could not load from the server.
The server decides what an administrator may do. This view gives no more rights than the server already gives.
%1$s cannot sign in or use the app until the account is reactivated. Nothing is deleted and all devices and chats stay.
%1$s can sign in and use the app again.
%1$s gets the same rights as you: create invitations, suspend and remove users and read the server\'s log.
%1$s becomes an ordinary user. There must always be at least one active administrator.
The code is shown only once. When %1$s uses it, the password changes, all of %1$s\'s devices are signed out and a new device is created. Give the code to the person in a way you both trust.
The code is shown only now. The app does not store it and it cannot be fetched again. If you close this box you must create a new code.
Whoever knows the code can take over the account, but cannot read old messages. The contacts\' apps show that the person has a new device.
The account is closed, all devices and sessions are removed and the user leaves all chats. This cannot be undone.
This chat is no longer available
Confirm with your own password. A signed-in session alone is not enough.
The device is signed out at once and its keys and queued messages are deleted. Use it if the phone is lost.
Push: the push server did not answer (%1$d failed in a row)
Push: refused with answer %1$d (%2$d failed in a row)
The code stops working. Anyone who already used it keeps their account.
The database is at %1$s but the server needs %2$s
The server\'s event log, newest first. The app shows only the event, the time and who did it, never addresses.
